name: Point of sale
summary: One bonded order at the counter: buyer and seller, no processor in between.
description: The simplest trade Figaro secures: a buyer and a seller settle a purchase directly. Both lock a stake worth more than the deal, so honoring it is the only profitable move — no card network, no payment processor, no chargeback department. The buyer picks how the goods change hands (on-site, pickup) at checkout; one signature settles it.
